app.title: NameSnipe
app.subtitle: A safe local-first Python TUI/CLI for searching, checking, and registering domains through Cloudflare Registrar API.
app.safety_line: Local-first. No database. No telemetry. Dry-run by default.
security.live_purchase_warning: Live purchase can charge your Cloudflare account and may be irreversible.
security.confirm_phrase_required: Enter the confirmation phrase exactly to continue.
security.token_never_displayed: API token is stored securely and is never displayed.
search.run_check_next: Run namesnipe check before planning or buying.
buy.dry_run_only: Dry-run only. No registration request was sent.
buy.price_changed_abort: Price changed during the final check. Purchase aborted.
buy.status_accepted: Registration request accepted. Do not retry blindly; check status later.
buy.confirm_intro: You are about to buy {count} domain(s) for {amount} {currency}.
config.max_price_usd: Default max price per domain in USD
config.token_saved_keyring: API token saved to system keyring.
config.token_env_required: Keyring is unavailable. Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in your local environment.
cli.check.help: Check domain availability and prices in real time.
cli.plan.help: Create a local purchase plan JSON file.
cli.buy.help: Execute a dry-run or confirmed live purchase from a plan.
cli.file.help: Read domains from a text file.
cli.live.help: Send live billable registration requests after confirmation.
tui.restart_required: Restart TUI to apply language changes everywhere.
tui.placeholder: This first version wires the local-first safety workflow. CLI commands perform API operations.
tui.no_token_logged: Logs redact tokens and Authorization headers.
tui.local_state_only: TUI list state is local to this process.
errors.token_missing: Cloudflare API token is missing. Use namesnipe init or set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
errors.account_id_missing: Cloudflare Account ID is missing. Run namesnipe init.
errors.budget_exceeded: {domain} costs {price} USD, above the per-domain budget of {budget} USD.
errors.total_budget_exceeded: Estimated total {total} USD exceeds the batch budget of {budget} USD.
errors.premium_rejected: Premium domains are rejected by default: {domains}.
errors.confirm_phrase_mismatch: Confirmation phrase did not match. Purchase aborted.
errors.recent_check_required: {domain} does not have a recent domain-check result.
errors.domain_status_changed: Domain availability or status changed during the final check. Purchase aborted.
errors.search_results_not_buyable: Search results are candidates only and cannot be purchased directly. Run namesnipe check first.
errors.mixed_currency: Plan contains mixed currencies and cannot be safely totaled.
